thread:
marie_pm: Heads-up — Sales needs a one-page, auditable playbook for our "priority traffic shedding" feature. They want assurances for paid customers during sudden surges and a clear pilot checklist.

devin_eng: Got it. High-level constraints: paid customers must never be silently dropped. Preferred order: lighter model -> CPU sync -> async queue -> reject only as last resort. Free tier can be more aggressive.

sasha_sre: Safety goals to include in the playbook: paid introduced errors <0.5%, paid p95 within +50ms of baseline, and no cascading queue growth. All should be enforced with flag-driven kill-switches.

alex_research: For experiments, propose two A/B arms: A = model-first fallbacks (quant small -> cpu-sync -> async), B = token-budget shedding (per-session token caps then drop low-priority). Track per-tier latency, success_rate, cost_per_token, and a small quality signal on a 10-prompt set.

marie_pm: Sales also asked for: canary plan for paid accounts, an explicit rollback recipe, and dashboard views per tier. We should include a short FAQ for pilots.

devin_eng: Draft rollout phases for the doc: 1) internal dev canary, 2) paid-canary (5% of paid, geo-split), 3) widen to 20% paid + 5% free, 4) regional expansion and default enable.

sasha_sre: Operational guardrails to list: kill-switch if paid errors_pct >= 0.5% over 120s -> immediate rollback; pause region if p95 latency >= 200% of baseline. Circuit-breaker actions: revert routing, enable stronger batching, or enable per-tenant caps.

marie_pm: We need a Console-preview snippet SEs can read (keep it flat/simple). Devin, can you provide?

devin_eng: Console preview (human-friendly lines for SEs and customers):

flag: priority_shed_v1
enabled: true
rollout_paid: 0.05
rollout_free: 0.01
paid_policy_order: prefer=base-large, fallback=quant-small, fallback=cpu-sync, fallback=async-queue
free_policy_order: prefer=base-large, fallback=cpu-sync, drop=reject-low-priority
kill_switch_errors_pct: 0.5
kill_switch_p95_increase_pct: 200
kill_switch_window_s: 120

(This is meant for the Sales / SE Console preview; the real schema in the PR is structured.)

lina_support: For pilot comms: short FAQ, opt-in form, and exact logging keys so SEs can show customers which fallback path hit (model name + reason). That transparency is critical for pilots.

alex_research: A/B details: split paid canary 50/50 A vs B. Run quality checks against 10 canonical prompts using embedding similarity delta; define a pass/fail threshold before widening.

sasha_sre: Add resource-aware rule: if GPU memory pressure > 80% in a region, escalate fallback ordering earlier for that region. Tag affected slices as "region-protect" so paid slices get stricter protection rules.

deploy-bot: Canary started: priority_shed_v1 -> paid 5% free 1% (canary_id: ps-3148) by @devin_eng at 2024-11-05T15:02:10Z

devin_eng: Minimal dashboard endpoints to add to Console (for docs): /dash/flags/priority_shed_v1/traffic-breakdown, /dash/flags/priority_shed_v1/errors-by-tier, /dash/flags/priority_shed_v1/fallback-paths. Also add a daily digest during rollout: paid_canary, paid_baseline, free_canary with cost delta and top-10 tenants by request.

marie_pm: Contingency bullets for the playbook: paid errors spike -> flip kill-switch -> notify oncall -> rollback; A/B quality regression -> pause experiment + revert; regional instability -> pause region only. Keep the runbook to one page.

lina_support: I'll draft the pilot email and an SE runbook (includes logging keys, sample SLA language, and the opt-in link). Will post to #customer-success when ready.

sasha_sre: Action items summary for the thread: Devin finalize flag schema + Console preview (ETA 2d); Sasha implement kill-switch automation + dashboard widgets (ETA 3d); Lina pilot comms + SE runbook (ETA 2d); Alex define 10-prompt eval + instrumentation (ETA 4d).

devin_eng: I'll open the PR with schema and rollout script and link it here once ready.

deploy-bot: Canary ps-3148 baseline metrics collected (15m) — no tier-level SLA violations so far :white_check_mark:

marie_pm: Thanks — I'll turn this into the one-pager for Sales and Oncall. Keep edits minimal in PR to preserve auditability.
